header.title: Spinner
header.description: Circular loading indicator for short waits or waits of unknown length. Accepts sizes as tokens, pixels or any CSS length, three animation styles and a visible label. `Loader` is an alias of the same component.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the indicator and the code. Without `label`, the default name is `Loading`; pass `aria-label` to describe what's loading.
playground.label: Loading workspace

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Just the indicator, with size `md` and tone `primary`. It's announced as `role="status"`; without visible text, pass `aria-label`.

label.title: With label
label.description: `label` adds visible text next to the indicator. That's what gets announced, and `aria-label` is ignored.

placement.title: Label placement
placement.description: `labelPlacement` puts the text beside (`end`, default) or below (`bottom`) the indicator.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts the tokens `sm`, `md` (default), `lg`, `xl`, `2xl`, `3xl` and `4xl`, which follow the icon scale. The stroke width adapts to the size.

customSize.title: Custom size
customSize.description: `size` also accepts a number (pixels) or any CSS length. In that case the `--custom` class is applied.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` sets the color: `primary` (default), `secondary`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info`, `neutral` or `current`, which inherits the container color. The label doesn't follow the tone: this example passes `text-current` through `classNames.label`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `variant` changes the animation: `ring` (spinning ring, default), `dots` (dots in a row) or `circle-dots` (dots in a circle).

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` (or `isDisabled`) dims the indicator, turns it gray, stops the animation and removes `aria-busy`. Useful for a paused task.

inline.title: Inline
inline.description: With `tone="current"` and `size="sm"` it blends into chips or text with their own color. If the adjacent text already explains the state, use `aria-hidden` to avoid repeating it.

overlay.title: Over a panel
overlay.description: A common case: a spinner with a label below covers the panel while it refreshes. The panel gets `aria-busy` while loading.

texts.title: Weekly sales
texts.text: Revenue grew 12% compared to the previous week, with peaks on Thursday and Saturday.

alias.title: Loader alias
alias.description: `Loader` is the same component as `Spinner`, with the same props.

header.title: Spinner API
header.description: API reference for the Spinner React component: props, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `Loader` is an alias. `spinnerSize` holds the token scale and `resolveSpinnerSize` turns any `size` into a CSS length.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts <div> attributes except children, and they go to the container along with ref, id and className. classNames adds classes to root, indicator and label. The indicator is a gem-system icon with aria-hidden.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.status: The container has role="status" and aria-busy="true". If you don't pass another role, it also gets aria-live="polite".
a11y.label: Without label, the default name is "Loading". Pass aria-label or aria-labelledby to describe what's loading.
a11y.name: With label, the visible text is announced and aria-label is ignored.
a11y.decorative: If the adjacent text already conveys the state, pass aria-hidden to avoid announcing it twice.
a11y.disabled: disabled removes aria-busy and adds data-disabled; role and name stay.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Container. Defines the variables. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`.
rules.size: Size token: `--sm`, `--md`, `--lg`, `--xl`, `--2xl`, `--3xl` or `--4xl`. Adjusts text and gap.
rules.custom: Applied when `size` is a number or a CSS length.
rules.label: Visible text. Receives `classNames.label`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Spinner's own variables. Tone and size classes have the same specificity, so use `.gem-spinner.your-class` and a `[data-theme="dark"]` variant.

items.--gem-spinner-color: Indicator color. Set by the tone. The label doesn't use it.
items.--gem-spinner-gap: Gap between indicator and label. Grows with the size.

items.--gem-color-{tone}-600: Color for each tone (`primary`, `secondary`, `success`, `warning`, `error`, `info`). Dark mode uses the palette.
items.--gem-space-2: Default gap between indicator and label.
items.--gem-space-3: Gap for sizes `xl` to `3xl` and custom sizes.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

items.size: Indicator size: a token, a number in pixels or a CSS length.
items.tone: Indicator color. `current` inherits the container color.
items.label: Visible text next to the indicator. When present, `aria-label` is ignored.
items.disabled: Dims the indicator, stops the animation and removes `aria-busy`.
items.role: Container role. If you change it, `aria-live` isn't added.
items.aria-labelledby: Id of an element that names the indicator.
